videos.caption: Xi Jinping's Awkward Moment With Morocco's Crown Prince Goes Viral A simple dining moment turned into an unexpectedly intriguing interaction between Chinese President Xi Jinping and Moroccan Crown Prince Moulay Hassan. Xi appeared to hold his food without eating, seemingly unsure how to proceed. The moment continued until someone demonstrated what to do, after which Xi finally began eating. It was a small detail, but it caught attention because even the most formal diplomatic gatherings can produce unscripted moments that feel surprisingly human. When world leaders meet, every handshake, expression, and gesture can attract scrutiny. But a brief pause at the dinner table can also be just that: a moment of uncertainty in an unfamiliar setting. Sometimes, the most memorable moments in diplomacy happen far away from the negotiating table. What do you think happened here: a cultural misunderstanding, or simply an awkward moment? #XiJinping #morocco #Diplomacy #ViralMoment...
